messages:
Sam: Quick sync — post-launch follow-on. We need to pick hotpath owners for the next 2 sprints. Current inputs: 3 P1 bugs (streaming edge, token inflation, routing fallback), 4 strong customer feature asks (pinning model version, per-route qps limits, better cost dashboard, webhook retries). Who can take what?
Elaine: I can own the prioritization rubric. Proposal: P1 bugs get block timebox (48h triage + owner) and any customer feature that affects SLA gets prioritized over non-SLA features.
Devon: From infra: we have ~20% spare dev capacity next sprint if we defer noncritical infra refactors. I can take the streaming edge bug with an infra pairing.
Ana: Support: two very large customers hit the token inflation issue — they flagged it as impacting billing accuracy. We need comms + rolling mitigation (disable prefix cache) before a full fix.
Mike: Eng constraints: fixing token inflation is risky for perf changes. Suggest a canary: rollback to last-known-good model variant for affected customers while we patch. I can allocate an eng + owner if we get agreement.
Sam: @Devon and @Mike can you pair on the canary plan? Also need a decision on feature freeze window — Elaine?
Elaine: Feature freeze for 72h after release is my recommendation. New noncritical features wait until next sprint. Critical customer asks that unblock revenue get exemptions with PM signoff.
triage-bot: Automated summary: https://boards.redwood.com/board/XYZ - 3 P1 bugs, 4 customer requests, suggested owners: Devon (streaming), Mike (token inflation), Sam (routing fallback).
Ana: I'll prepare the customer comms draft for the webhook retries and token billing note. Can someone confirm PS handoff?
Mike: I can own the routing fallback; will add a canary job and test plan. Devon + I will pair on streaming edge.
Sam: OK putting this into the short plan:
- Owners: Devon (streaming edge), Mike (token inflation + routing fallback), Elaine (prio rubric + gating).
- Immediate actions: Ana to send comms + mitigation steps (today), Devon+Mike to run canary (48h), Elaine to lock feature freeze (now).
- Follow-ups: 1h sync tomorrow 10:30am to confirm rollouts and reassign any overflow.
Elaine: Sounds good. I'll also add a quick acceptance checklist for each item (biz impact, rollback plan, monitoring alerts).
Sam: Thanks all — if you can add brief status lines to the board card by EOD we'll avoid scope drift. :thumbsup:
